Regionality and power system constraints
Based on the concept of a bidding zone, we recognize that the main island of Japan could be divided into nine areas, even though the grid is physically connected and there is physical power flexibility. In Japan, renewable energy procurement options differ depending on the power system, and it is particularly difficult to procure renewable energy in urban areas (Kanto, Kansai, Chukyo). We request that you consider designing rules that are fair and flexible, taking into account these regional disparities and additional costs.
